description: Governed entry point for Ohio publisher-Open Child Care Center acquisition and local-review normalization.
redirect_policy: Fixed official Ohio layer, item, count/status, ID/page and four reviewed notice URLs; redirects rejected, credentials omitted and caller endpoints prohibited.
retry: Only bounded transient, timeout, 429 and 5xx retries; changed schema, scope, notices, ownership or cancellation stops acquisition. No automatic job restart.
checkpoint: Persist current source-use evidence before IDs/rows, every selected response, verified child releases and terminal receipt; atomically advance the governed pointer last.
idempotency: Immutable UUID releases. Completed acquisition evidence is reusable for offline reprocessing; failed runs preserve the prior pointer. A requested fresh refresh is a new source run.
cancellation: Cooperative transport and IPC cancellation; remove only owned unpublished staging and preserve completed evidence and app history.
retention_profile: Internal selected source evidence and local-review normalization. ZIP5/ZIP4 remain separate; nullable source points only; no business polygons or public record export.
